**Sqex::Thread namespace fully mapped (10 classes)**: 4 primitives (Mutex, Thread, ThreadManager, ReadWriteLock) + 6 Queue<T> template instantiations. The 6 Queue<T> instantiations are: Queue<Application::Misc::AsyncWorkTaskInterface*> (vftable 0x00F90A20, TD 0x01269750) - async work item queue; Queue<Application::Main::MainPacket> (vftable 0x00F90FDC, TD 0x01269BC0) - main thread message queue; Queue<Application::Scene::ScenePacket> (vftable 0x00F931C0, TD 0x0126A7E0 BCS-Y-1733/1734) - scene tick queue; Queue<Component::Resource::Resource*> (vftable 0x0110893C, TD 0x0130B4E0) - resource loader queue; Queue<Component::Install::InstallWriter::WriteEntry*> (vftable 0x0110D508, TD 0x0130C3A0) - install writer queue; Queue<Sqex::Http::Event*> (vftable 0x01113054, TD 0x0130ECD0) - HTTP event queue.

**Application::Main::MainPacket identified**: vftable 0x00F90EF8 - the message type that flows through Queue<MainPacket> to the MainModule for main-thread processing. Sibling architectural role to ScenePacket (BCS-Y-1715) for scene-thread processing. Each *Packet class's vftable slot 3 is presumably the 'process this message on the main/scene thread' handler.

**Architecture pattern: Holder<EmbeddedQueue<T>>**: All 3 decomped Queue<T> instantiations follow the same pattern - a HOLDER class embeds the Queue<T> at a specific offset. The dtor signature is consistent: `*this = Holder::vftable; destroy subobjects; this[offset] = Queue<T>::vftable; _free trailing memory`. This embeds the Queue<T> as a subobject (not by inheritance and not by pointer), giving the holder direct control over the queue lifetime.

**Application::Misc::* (third namespace partially mapped)**: the FUN_004C3830 dtor (84 bytes) writes a `Application::Misc::AsyncWorkTaskInterface*` queue vftable at parent+0x74. The parent class name is not yet identified (function signature is `__fastcall(int param_1)` not `(undefined4*)` so the decomp lost the structural context). Probably an Application::Misc::AsyncWorkManager or similar. Deferred to Application::Misc::* namespace enumeration.

**Sqex::Thread::Thread/ThreadManager are the OS-level thread wrappers**: ThreadManager (vftable 0x01110678) has only 2 vftable writers - consistent with a singleton (ctor + dtor). Thread (vftable 0x01110688) has 3 writers (ctor + 2 dtor variants). These are presumably the C++ wrappers around Windows CreateThread/WaitForSingleObject. The SceneThreadImpl and MainModule probably hold Thread instances internally.

**Cross-link to followups**: BCS-Y-1733 (Queue<ScenePacket> vftable) and BCS-Y-1734 (Queue<ScenePacket> TD) had a deferred follow-up: 'Enumerate other Sqex::Thread::Queue<T> template instantiations'. Amendment to BCS-Y-1733 documents this distinction.

**Embedding offsets**: SceneThreadImpl owns Queue<ScenePacket> at +0x370 (~880 bytes from start); MainModule owns Queue<MainPacket> at +0x17928 (~96552 bytes from start).
